source_contract.format: Explicit JSONL override, otherwise the recorded history mode: canonical paginated SQLite when marked, exact-id JSONL discovery otherwise
source_contract.public_text: event_msg/item_completed UserMessage or AgentMessage with exact thread, turn and message IDs; text only; assistant commentary or final_answer
source_contract.final_capture: Real final_answer and task_complete for the exact requested turn
source_contract.validation: Available is source discovery only; public prefix and capture integrity checks still apply. An unavailable marked-paginated source never falls back to a retained JSONL
source_contract.unsupported_stores: Remote-only histories and unverified schemas require a separately verified exporter; no metadata or public text is synthesized

historical_manifest_policy: Issued manifests remain unchanged; authorized tooling/docs repair supersedes their historical tooling hashes only. Mathematical source inputs/results unchanged.
